note: Amazon.de shopping events that the EB_DEALS band may mention (tools/build_deals.py, gate tools/check_deals.py). An event renders only when announced is true, a primary source is recorded, and today lies between show_from and end. The Prime-trial link is offered only for prime_only events: that is the one moment a reader has a reason of their own to want Prime, and the band never pushes the trial without one. When Amazon announces an event, add its dates, the quote and the source URL here; never from memory, never from a deal blog's forecast. Set show_from to null for a confirmed event covered on a specific buying guide without the shelf band. Optional guide_paths maps selected German shelf pages to existing buying guides.
